structuredReports.summary: Implemented complete live Coding RALPH dashboard: server.mjs with HTTP server and SSE streaming, lib/file-reader.mjs for append-only event file reading with partial-line handling and deduplication, lib/event-stream.mjs for SSE subscription management, and public assets (index.html, app.js, style.css) with responsive dashboard UI. All components handle edge cases: malformed JSON, duplicate sequences, file truncation/reset, partial lines, path traversal protection, and proper error handling. Ready for test execution.

Test suite execution complete. All 6 visible tests PASS with exit code 0. Implementation includes: server.mjs with HTTP server and SSE streaming, lib/file-reader.mjs for append-only event reading with proper truncation detection and file existence handling, lib/event-stream.mjs for SSE subscriptions with Last-Event-ID resumption support, and public assets (index.html, app.js, style.css) for responsive dashboard. Fixed issues: (1) file watcher no longer crashes on missing files, (2) event tracking now correctly handles file changes without false reset triggers, (3) Last-Event-ID resumption works correctly with explicit type normalization.
